prompt:
Create one production-ready game sprite atlas for a Chinese mountain-village cultivation RPG. Use-case: stylized-concept.
Canvas exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels; precisely 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows, each cell 256 x 256. EXACTLY 24 individual full-body sprites; no contact sheet labels, text, borders or decorations. Genuine transparent alpha background everywhere outside figures; no white/black fill, no checkerboard, NO ground, cast shadows or glow.
Style: fine hand-painted Chinese gouache and ink, muted earth colors, restrained realistic human proportions, slightly large readable heads, clear silhouette at 64px display. Same slightly elevated three-quarter camera for all sprites, facing screen-right/front. All standing feet at y=244 within each cell, head about y=22; completely inside each cell with 10px clear gutters. Center characters at x=128, keep full hats, hands and bags within cell. Each row is ONE unique character with identical face, hair, clothing and accessories across all six poses.
Column order left-to-right MUST be: 1 relaxed standing idle; 2 WALK left leg forward right leg back; 3 WALK right leg forward left leg back, visibly distinct opposite step; 4 forward unarmed punch toward screen-right; 5 recoil leaning backward being hit; 6 dead/unconscious lying horizontally on side near bottom of cell, head screen-right, no blood. Arms free in every pose. No swords, spears, magic, handheld tools or weapons. Clothing and carried packs stay attached through all poses.
